paite: Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N Midiante khut ah kum sagih sung apekhia hi.
heading: Gideon
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

paite: Midiante'n Israelte azouta ua; huchi in Midiante ziak in tang ah kokhukte, kohawm leh kulhte abawl uhi.
english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n haichi achin khit un Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam mite ahong kuan ua; ava dou ua,
english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

paite: panmun ava khoh ua, Gaza tan in lei a thilpoute ahihsiatsak ua, Israel gam ah nek ding himhim ahawi kei ua, belam, bawng leh sabiltung tan in ahihse vek uhi.
english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

paite: Aganhonte uh leh apuaninte uh toh ahong kuan ua, khaupe bang in tampi ahong kuan ua; amaute leh asangawngsaute uh sim seng ahi kei, gam hihse dia hong kuan ahi uhi.
english: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.

paite: Huchi in Midiante ziak in Israelte akeniam mahmahta ua; huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA asamta uhi.
english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Midiante ziak a Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah zawlnei khat asawl a; ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, hichi in achi:
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh because of Midian,

paite: 'Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pitou a, saltanna inn a pan ka hon pikhia hi.
english: Yahweh sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

paite: Aiguptate khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah mi teng khut a pan ka hon hunkhia a, na ma uah amaute ka delhkhia a, agam uh nou ka hon pia hi.
english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, agam ua na tenna uh Amorte pathiante na lau ding uh ahi kei, ka chi hỉ'. Himahleh ka thugen na zui kei uh," achi hi.
english: I said to you, “I am Yahweh your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA angel ahong pai a, Ophrah a Abiezer mi Joash tosaw sing nuai ah atu hi. Atapa Gideon in Midiante muh louh ding in grep sukna khuk ah buh ana vua hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

paite: TOUPA angel akiang ah ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Nang mihat hangsan, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

paite: Gideon in akiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, ka kiang ua TOUPA om ahihleh bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua hiai thilte hong tung ahia? Ka pipute un, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan hon pitou hilou hia? chi a, athilhih lamdang ahon hilhte uh koilam a bangchi khinta ahia? Tu'n zaw, TOUPA'N hon pampaih ahita a, Midiante khut a hon peta ei ve," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t Yahweh bring us up from Egypt?’ But now Yahweh has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

paite: TOUPA'N, amah a-en a, akiang ah, "Hiai na hatna in kuan in, Midiante a pan Israelte hunkhia in. K'on sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, “Aw TOUPA, bangchi in ahia Israelte ka va hutkhiak mahmah ding? Ngai in, Manasseh suan lak a inkuan hatloupen ka hi ua, kei lah ka pa inkote lak a neupen ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

paite: TOUPA'N, akiang ah, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding hi, huchi in Midiante mi khat lel bang in na zou vek ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, nang mahmah in na hon pi chih chiamtehna banghiam hon musak in.
english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

paite: Na ma a lat ding thilpiak ka va lak a, na kiang a ka hong nawn masiah hiai a pan hehpih in ana paimang ke'n," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hong nawn masiah ka na om gige ding," achi hi.
english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”

paite: Insung ah Gideon alut a, kelnou leh tangbuang ephah khat silngou soh louh abawl a; seng ah asa akoih a, huai gel tuibel ah akoih a, tosaw sing nuai ah akiang a hon tawi in ahong lan hi.
english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

paite: Pathian angel in akiang ah, "Sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh la inla, hiai suang tung ah koih inla, atui pen sungkhia in,” achi hi. Huchibang in ama'n ahihta hi.
english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in achiangkhun tawi muk in sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akhoih a; suang a pan mei ahong pawt a, sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akangtum vek hi. Huan amuhlouhna ah TOUPA angel in apaimangsanta hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh’s angel departed out of his sight.

paite: Huchi in Gideon in, TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi. Gideon in, "Maizen, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, TOUPA angel kimaituah a mu ka kei maw," achi hi. "
english: Gideon saw that he was Yahweh’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh! Because I have seen Yahweh’s angel face to face!”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, Lungmuangtak in om inla, lau ke'n. Na si kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

paite: Huchi in Gideon in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, Jehovah Shalom asa hi. Tuni tan in Abiezerte gam Ophrah ah a-om lai hi.
english: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na pa bawngtaltuai, bawngtal nihna kum sagih a upa la inla, na pa neih Baal maitam hihchim inla, abul a sing a bawl Asherah phuk in.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

paite: Hiai suangpi tung ah zeneitak in TOUPA na Pathian a ding in maitam bawl inla, bawngtal nihna la inla, na phuk ding Asherah sing zang in halmang thillat lan in," achi hi.
english: Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

paite: Huchi in Gideon in asikhate lak a mi sawm api a, TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in ahihta hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apa inkote leh khopi a mite alauh ziak in, sun lai in ahih ngam kei a, zan lai in ahihta hi.
english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahweh had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

paite: Khopi a mite zingkhang a athoh uleh, ngai in, Baal maitam hihchip in ana om a, abul a Ashera phukpaih in ana om a, maitam tung ah bawngtal nihna lat in ana om hi.
english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

paite: "Hiai kua hih ahia?" chi in akihou ua, akidongtuah ua, azon khit un, "Joash tapa Gideon in hiai thil ahih ana hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”

paite: Huchi in khopi a mite'n Joash kiang ah, "Na tapa va pikhia in, asih ngeingei ding ahi. Baal maitam ahihchip ziak leh abul a Asherah aphuk ziak in,” achi uhi.
english: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”

paite: "Joash in amah hong kalh teng kiang ah, Baal gum ding na hi uh maw? Ama'n hon hondam ding hia? Kuapeuh amah gum zingsang mahmah a thah ding ahi. Pathian khat ahihleh amaitam ahihchip ziak in kigum leh akei dia," achi hi.
english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

paite: Huaiziak in huai ni in amah Jerubbaal asa uhi, amaitam hihchip ahih ziak in, "Baal in amah kalh heh," achi uhi.
english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

paite: Huchi in Midiante tengteng leh Amalekte leh suahlam mite akikhawm ua; lui akan ua, Jezreel Phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Kha Gideon tung ah ahong tung a; pengkul amut a; huchi in Abiezerte'n amah agum uhi.
english: But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

paite: Manasseh tengteng kiang ah mi ataisak a; huaite'n leng anaihkhawm uhi. Asherte, Zebulunte leh Naphtali teng kiang ah leng mite ataisak a; amau leng abehlaptouta uhi.
english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

paite: Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Na gen bang a ka khut a Israelte na hutkhiak dingleh,
english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

paite: ngai in, buhphual ah belam mul ka koih dia, belam mul tung kia a daitui ana om a, leitual ana hul vekleh, na gen bang in ka khut in Israelte na hunkhe ding, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

paite: Huchibang ahong hi a, azing zingsangpi a thou a, belam mul asukleh belkuang dim tui atakkhia hi.
english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

paite: Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka tung ah heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen nawn ding. Hehpih in, khatvei kia belam mul in hon ze-etsak nawn in. Tutung in ahihleh belam mul kia hul henla, leitual ah daitui om nawn leuleu hen," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

paite: Huchibang in Pathian in huai zan in ahih a; belam mul kia ana hul a, leitual ah daitui ana om leuleu hi.
english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
